entities.summary: John William Shurna is an American–Lithuanian professional basketball player who plays for Força Lleida of the Spanish Liga ACB. He is the 2012 Big Ten scoring champion. He played in the 2012 NBA Summer League with the Atlanta Hawks. He then signed with the New York Knicks, but was waived at the end of the preseason.
